description: Allocation of Land blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estate Development Programme is implemented by the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development with a view to promoting industries at the regional level. Under the said programme, basic infrastructure facilities are developed on the lands identified for the establishment of industrial estates and thereafter land blocks are allocated to suitable investors from the relevant industrial estates. After evaluating the investment proposals submitted for the implementation of investment projects in regional industrial estates, the Regional Industrial Services Committee established as per the provisions of the Industrial Promotion Act No. 46 of 1990 and the Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development have recommended the allocation of land blocks for 23 projects. The value of the investments to be made through those projects is about Rs. 2,805.26 million. Furthermore, it is predicted that approximately 870 direct employment opportunities will be generated through the said industrial projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to provide the relevant land blocks from 13 regional industrial estates to the said 23 investors for the establishment of new industries on lease basis for a period of 35 years, was approved by the Cabinet.
